title: ADMT Sixty-Day Cure Period Before Enforcement
content: Beginning January 1, 2027, violations of the Colorado ADMT Act are enforced by the Attorney General as deceptive trade practices, with no private right of action. A regulated party may cure an alleged violation within 60 days of notice; the cure route is available through January 1, 2030.
source_citation: Colorado SB 26-189 (2026 Regular Session), Governor Signed May 14, 2026
